'''Koa Delko''' was a [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. He was present at the trials of [[Demagol]] and [[Dorjander Kace]] as the prosecutor.<ref>{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?t=16498|thread=Unknown thread|nobackup=1}}</ref>

==Biography==
In [[3963 BBY]], Koa Delko represented the government and participated in the trial of [[Demagol]], a member of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], who committed crimes against the Republic. Bearing in mind that the trial would be considered a show trial for symbolic condemnation for all [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], the prisoner accused Delko for the publicity of his crimes and heated up the many onlookers. Delko refused to listen to those protestations from him.<ref name="KOTOR 47" />
